title: Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-), Anthropic Enterprise organization key (sk-ant-api01-) and 1 more: one-property twin (prefix) (project-policy)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: sk-ant-admin01- (the Console Admin API key class) in place of this class; same body, prefix: sk-ant-api03- (the Claude API key class) in place of this class; same body, and prefix: the documented lowercase prefix upper-cased, and 1 more. Twin of "Anthropic Enterprise organization key (sk-ant-api01-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
